)
  # Enable it temporarily to check the coverage on macOS.
  set (XPACK_ENABLE_COVERAGE false)
endif ()
{%- if testsConfig.useStaticLibrary %}

# The libraries are compiled before the platform library, so they need to get
# the same compile options.
add_compile_common_private_options (
  {{nameDash}}-static-library
)

if (XPACK_ENABLE_COVERAGE)
  add_compile_coverage_private_options (
    {{nameDash}}-static-library
  )
endif ()
{%- endif %}

{%- assign testUpperCase = testName | upcase %}
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

if (XPACK_ENABLE_{{testUpperCase}}_TEST)
  add_native_test_executable ({{testName}}-test)
  target_link_native_test_libraries ({{testName}}-test tests::{{testName}})

{%- if testName == 'unit' %}

  if (XPACK_ENABLE_COVERAGE)
    add_compile_coverage_private_options ({{testName}}-test)
    add_link_coverage_private_options ({{testName}}-test)
  endif ()
{%- elsif testName == 'minimal' and packageScopedName == '@micro-os-plus/micro-test-plus' %}

  # Only for this test, always define the trace macros, to check if the tracing
  # support compiles  correctly.
  target_compile_definitions (
    minimal-test
    PRIVATE MICRO_OS_PLUS_MICRO_TEST_PLUS_TRACE_CONSTRUCTORS_ENABLED
            MICRO_OS_PLUS_MICRO_TEST_PLUS_TRACE_ENABLED
  )
{%- endif %}

  xpack_display_target_lists ({{testName}}-test)
  message (VERBOSE "A> {{testName}}-test")

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # TAP reporter

  # --verbose
  add_test (
    NAME "{{testName}}-test-verbose" COMMAND {{testName}}-test one two --output-file {{testName}}-test-verbose.tap --verbose
  )

{%- if testName == 'unit' %}

  if (XPACK_ENABLE_COVERAGE)
    set_tests_properties (
      "{{testName}}-test-verbose"
      PROPERTIES ENVIRONMENT
                 "LLVM_PROFILE_FILE={{testName}}-test-verbose.profraw"
    )

    add_test (
      NAME "{{testName}}-test-verbose-coverage"
      COMMAND bash "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../../scripts/show-coverage.sh"
              {{testName}}-test {{testName}}-test-verbose
    )
    set_tests_properties (
      "{{testName}}-test-verbose-coverage"
      PROPERTIES DEPENDS "{{testName}}-test-verbose"
    )
  endif ()
{%- endif %}

  add_compare_files_test (
    NAME "{{testName}}-test-verbose-compare"
    DEPENDS "{{testName}}-test-verbose"
    FILES "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/{{testName}}-test-verbose.tap"
          "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../../assets/tap/{{testName}}-test.tap"
  )

  # default
  add_test (
    NAME "{{testName}}-test" COMMAND {{testName}}-test one two --output-file {{testName}}-test.tap
  )
  add_compare_files_test (
    NAME "{{testName}}-test-compare"
    DEPENDS "{{testName}}-test"
    FILES "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/{{testName}}-test.tap"
          "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../../assets/tap/{{testName}}-test.tap"
  )

  # --quiet
  add_test (NAME "{{testName}}-test-quiet"
            COMMAND {{testName}}-test one two --output-file {{testName}}-test-quiet.tap --quiet
  )
  add_compare_files_test (
    NAME "{{testName}}-test-quiet-compare"
    DEPENDS "{{testName}}-test-quiet"
    FILES "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/{{testName}}-test-quiet.tap"
          "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../../assets/tap/{{testName}}-test.tap"
  )

  # --silent
  add_test (NAME "{{testName}}-test-silent"
            COMMAND {{testName}}-test one two --output-file {{testName}}-test-silent.tap --silent

  add_compare_files_test (
    NAME "{{testName}}-test-silent-compare"
    DEPENDS "{{testName}}-test-silent"
    FILES "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/{{testName}}-test-silent.tap"

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Human reporter

  # --verbose
  add_test (
    NAME "{{testName}}-test-reporter-human-verbose" COMMAND {{testName}}-test one two --reporter human --output-file {{testName}}-test-verbose.txt --verbose
  )
  add_compare_files_test (
    NAME "{{testName}}-test-reporter-human-verbose-compare"
    DEPENDS "{{testName}}-test-reporter-human-verbose"
    FILES "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/{{testName}}-test-verbose.txt"
          "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../../assets/txt/{{testName}}-test.txt"
  )

  # default
  add_test (
    NAME "{{testName}}-test-reporter-human" COMMAND {{testName}}-test one two --reporter human --output-file {{testName}}-test.txt
  )
  add_compare_files_test (
    NAME "{{testName}}-test-reporter-human-compare"
    DEPENDS "{{testName}}-test-reporter-human"
    FILES "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/{{testName}}-test.txt"
          "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../../assets/txt/{{testName}}-test.txt"
  )

  # --quiet
  add_test (
    NAME "{{testName}}-test-reporter-human-quiet" COMMAND {{testName}}-test one two --reporter human --output-file {{testName}}-test-quiet.txt --quiet
  )
  add_compare_files_test (
    NAME "{{testName}}-test-reporter-human-quiet-compare"
    DEPENDS "{{testName}}-test-reporter-human-quiet"
    FILES "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/{{testName}}-test-quiet.txt"
          "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../../assets/txt/{{testName}}-test-quiet.txt"
  )

  # --silent
  add_test (
    NAME "{{testName}}-test-reporter-human-silent" COMMAND {{testName}}-test one two --reporter human --output-file {{testName}}-test-silent.txt --silent
  )
  add_compare_files_test (
    NAME "{{testName}}-test-reporter-human-silent-compare"
    DEPENDS "{{testName}}-test-reporter-human-silent"
